review_description: The quote process was very straight forward.The arrived on the day, on time as planned. Work was completed on the day, all rubbish removed.Their customer service was very satisfactory, not pushy like some other sharks out there.All the companies you referred were polite and helpful, all prices were much of a muchness, so local support became the overall deciding factor.
Great people to deal with from start to finish highly recommend this firm Polite Tidy Neat and Punctual And Great After Sales Service.
Currently have panels and in middle on inverter installation.  Very smooth experience.

Every time a visit was arranged the company came at the appointed time.  I was promptly notified if anything changed in the supply or installation schedule.  The installers did a great job and left the site free of any rubbish. The owner of the business took the time to answer all of the questions I had.  I would recommend this Company to anyone wishing to purchase and install a Solar Power System in the Newcastle, NSW area.
